prompt: A customer reported that the checkout flow crashes when the cart has more than 50 items. They sent a screenshot and a rough repro. Please capture this properly as a bug in beads with the right labels and linked follow-up work.
assertions: Creates a bug rather than a generic task
Uses the source:external label for the customer-reported bug
Captures steps to reproduce plus expected and actual behavior clearly
Adds a linked post-mortem task because this is an external bug
Keeps the issue body concrete and executable instead of vague
